The plate is square-ish and about 26 cm across (assuming a dinner plate). The scrambled egg covers roughly 200 px × 130 px of a plate that is about 460 px wide. That works out to about 11 cm × 7 cm, but the pile is irregular, so the real footprint is smaller, around 50 cm². At a height of about 1.5 cm, the volume is roughly 60 cm³. Scrambled egg is loose, so I assumed a density of about 0.7 g/cm³, which gives roughly 45 g. I added a small allowance for the stray bit at the top, which brings it to about 50 g.
